landing.subtitle: Something is waiting for you. But first — a tiny mission.

reasons.title: Some things I should have said out loud…

items.text: Every time my phone lights up with your name, the day gets 10% better. Science calls it dopamine. I call it you.
You make ordinary Tuesdays feel like something worth remembering.
Laughing with you is my favorite sound in any room.
I've run out of reasons to wait. So here I am, asking properly.

heartCatch.title: Catch the hearts to unlock your letter

questions.q: Who is the better cook between us two?

options.reaction: Then I get to be your taste-tester for life 😌
Then I'll happily spend my mornings just watching you cook ☕
Doesn't matter who cooks — it's you I'm hungry for 😏
Just us, no noise, nowhere to be. That's my favorite place 🕯️
Anywhere becomes an adventure the moment you're beside me 🌙
Long tables, slow evenings, and you sitting across from me 🍷

questions.q: How much do you like me?

options.reaction: A lot is a beautiful start… I plan on becoming your favorite habit 😉
Careful — say things like that and I'll never let you go 💘
Then we're even. You've had my heart since before I even knew it 💞

scratchCard.title: One more thing… scratch to reveal
scratchCard.hiddenText: {{herName}}, will you go on a date with me?

question.line: {{herName}}, will you go on a date with me?
noLoopCaptions: Okay, the universe has voted. It said YES.
question.giveUpLine: No worries 😊 (the Yes button will be here, glowing, forever)

celebration.headline: I knew it 😍
celebration.note: Best. Decision. Ever. Now let's make it official…

planner.heading: Now the important part — when do I get to see you?

send.heading: Seal the deal 📝

finale.title: See you soon 🥰
letter: Thank you for saying yes before I even finished being nervous.
I promise the date will be worth every heart you caught today.
And if you tap the heart below three times… well, see for yourself.

easterEgg.message: You found it. Bonus date unlocked. 😌💘
